title: Froot, O'Connell & Seasholes 2001 JFE flows applied to Japan MOF weekly data
note: Japan MOF publishes weekly foreign net purchases of Japanese equities (free). Rule sketch: 4-week net inflow in its top quintile means long JPN225 for 4 weeks. Froot-Ramadorai was dropped for non-free data; this uses the free MOF series. Fits gap 2 and gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only. 2026-11-02: not yet opened; next run start here.

title: Rapach, Ringgenberg & Zhou 2016 JFE: short interest predicts the market
note: Detrended aggregate short interest (log, linear trend fitted recursively). High SII means lower US500 returns next month. Data risk: needs a free short-interest history (exchange bimonthly reports); drop if none. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Jondeau, Zhang & Zhu 2019 JFE: average skewness predicts market returns
note: Cross-sectional average of monthly skewness of daily returns (use the 49 French industry portfolios as a proxy for stocks; note the proxy). High average skewness predicts lower US500 returns next month. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.
